body:
**Preferred gene-related syndrome label**
_TAB2_-related syndromic congenital heart disease


**Synonyms:**
cardiac anomalies-short stature-joint hypermobility-facial dysmorphism syndrome due to TAB2 mutation, MONDO:0971094
congenital heart defects, multiple types, 2; MONDO:0014000

**Parent term:**
congenital heart disease, MONDO:0005453

**Definition:**
_TAB2_-related syndromic congenital heart disease is characterized by congenital heart disease variable presenting with additional features including polyvalvular heart disease, growth failure, joint hypermobility, hypotonia, and hearing loss (PMIDs: 20493459, 27452334, 28386937, 31959127, 31981616, 34741306, 34456334, 34995729, 37153890). 

**Definition source:**
PMIDs: 20493459, 27452334, 28386937, 31959127, 31981616, 34741306, 34456334, 34995729, 37153890

**Children terms (if applicable)** Should any existing terms be re-classified as children underneath this new proposed term? 

**Your nano-attribution (ORCID) or URL for a working group:** ClinGen Congenital Heart Disease GCEP
https://clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40130/

comments.body:
@kezang-tshering thank you for this issue! I have added the clingen preferred name and definition to MONDO:0014000. Since it appears that MONDO:0971094 represents the same concept as MONDO:0014000, I have added MONDO:0971094 to the obsoletion list. 

Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

title: [NTR/gene] TAB2-related syndromic congenital heart disease
